Author: VierAI
Name: Friend Status Sweep
Description:
The friend list only refreshes friends on other worlds when you press each one's refresh button. Friend Status Sweep presses it for you: on demand with /fsweep, the Refresh All button in the Friend List or the Start button, only friends not on your current world, one friend at a time, waiting for each answer before the next, with a gap between requests. Works with the Friend List window closed. When it finishes you get a toast and a chat line with how many friends are online and who came online. Stop any time with /fsweep stop. Each sweep sends one friend-info request to the server per off-world friend, like pressing their refresh button. An optional repeat timer (automatic sweeps) is off by default and can't be set below 15 minutes. Pauses in combat, duties, cutscenes, GPose and zone changes, and backs off if answers stop coming.

AI generated code.
